mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% for three consecutive months reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.25% and remains above for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 60-day forward returns in all such regimes, or the 3-month moving average of FEDFUNDS never exceeds 5.25% during the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL inflation rate exceeds 3% for two consecutive months, the market anticipates a pre-emptive rate hike, causing S&P 500 forward returns to turn negative over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 3% and remains above for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: Inflation exceeds 3% for 2+ months but S&P 500 20-day forward returns remain positive, or the CPIAUCSL never exceeds 3% in the observed window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in monthly PAYEMS (employment growth) of more than 0.5% above the prior quarter's average coincides with a 5-day positive S&P 500 forward return, as labor market strength is interpreted as a growth signal.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly change > 0.5% above prior quarter average
failure_condition: PAYEMS shows strong growth but S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly GDPC1 personal consumption expenditure grows faster than the previous month by at least 2%, the S&P 500 expects higher corporate profits over the next 20 trading days, producing a positive return.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 monthly growth rate > 2% relative to prior month
failure_condition: GDPC1 shows rapid growth but SPX 20-day returns are negative or flat.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both INDPRO (industrial production) and HOUST (housing starts) by at least 1% month-over-month indicates soft supply constraints, which the market interprets as a risk of deflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous and HOUST < previous by at least 1% each
regime_hint: supply-side contraction in a recessionary cycle
failure_condition: Both INDPRO and HOUST decline but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3% for three consecutive months, the labor market is perceived as strengthening, prompting the market to price in higher wage growth and thus a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains below 3% but SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of persistent FEDFUNDS below 1%, the low-rate environment lowers the real discount rate, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 1% but SPX 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of RSAFS (retail sales) falls by more than 4% from its peak in the past 12 months, it signals weak consumer demand, which the market anticipates by selling off equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: 3-month RSAFS MA is down >4% from its 12-month peak
regime_hint: retail demand contraction after a boom
failure_condition: RSAFS shows large decline but SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
